name: lights_control
description: Read/control home lights through the lights gateway (Kasa/TP-Link supported).

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: MUST be exactly one of: list_lights, set_light_power, set_light_brightness, set_light_color, set_scene.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Required for set_light_power. MUST be one of: on, off.

arguments_prompt:
Use this tool for light controls exposed through your lights bridge endpoint (Kasa supported).

Required:
- `command`: MUST be exactly one of `list_lights`, `set_light_power`, `set_light_brightness`, `set_light_color`, `set_scene`

Selectors (both optional):
- `light_id` — target a specific light by its ID
- `room` — target lights in a specific room (substring match on device alias, e.g. "Living Room", "Bedroom")
- **OMIT both `room` and `light_id` to target ALL lights.** Do NOT pass "all" as a room name — just leave the field out.

Conditional fields:
- `state` for `set_light_power` (`on` or `off`)
- `brightness_pct` for `set_light_brightness` (0-100)
- `color` for `set_light_color` (e.g., "warm white", "#ff0000")
- `scene_name` for `set_scene`

Notes:
- Kasa HS220 dimmer supports `list_lights`, `set_light_power`, and `set_light_brightness`.
- `set_light_color` and `set_scene` may not be available for dimmer switches.
